prompt: Victory: the animal stays on all four legs the whole clip, lifts its head and barks or roars once, then stands proudly still. It never stands up on its hind legs, never changes its body shape. The figure keeps exactly the same body, the same face and the same limbs for the whole clip. The whole figure stays inside the frame, empty green space above the head. No visual effects, no flashes, no trails, no glow, no particles.
